mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: the explanation connected seawater circulation, heated rock and dissolved chemicals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the continent was less engaging because it was the only offered action and its role in the mineral goal was not yet clear.

surprise.text: Combining moving plates with water produced a trench rather than a spring, showing how subduction forms deep ocean trenches.

arbitrary.text: The continent combination felt somewhat arbitrary when chosen: it was the only option, and I could not yet see how it would bring minerals to the sea.

continue.text: Yes. The vent and weathering sequences made geological processes understandable, and I would be curious to see what the world makes next.
